source_text: Omnis masculus domus et empticius circumcidatur. Domestici ecclesiae et pretio Christi empti uno signo signantur.
pass_a_gloss: Every male of-house and purchased let-be-circumcised. House-members of-church and by-price of-Christ bought with-one sign are-sealed.
pass_b_english: [[Every male of the household and every purchased servant is to be circumcised >> Bible:Genesis 17:12-13]]. House-members of the church and those [[bought with Christ’s price >> Bible:1 Corinthians 6:20]] are sealed with one sign.
